name: code-review

summary.en: Matt Pocock’s review of changes since a fixed point along two axes — repository standards and the originating spec — run as parallel subagents.
summary.zh: Matt Pocock 的评审流程：针对某个基准点之后的改动，从仓库规范和原始需求两个维度并行评审。

upstreamDescription: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".
